## v1.8.0 — 2026-03-17

Version 1.8.0 introduces a comprehensive set of new features and improvements including a dashboard billing tab, enhanced logging with Pino, security headers (CSP and rate limiting), favicon support, database changelog migration capabilities, health check endpoint, and graceful shutdown functionality.

### ✨ Features

- Added dashboard billing tab for financial management functionality
- Implemented Pino logging framework for structured logging
- Added Content Security Policy (CSP) and rate limiting headers for enhanced security
- Added favicon.ico support for improved browser experience
- Implemented database changelog migration system for schema versioning
- Added /healthz endpoint for health check monitoring
- Implemented graceful shutdown functionality for improved service reliability

### Contributors
